title: fix(cli): launch Claude Code on Windows
author: ismailbanouigu

gist.summary: Fixed the Polli CLI’s Claude Code smoke test failing to launch on Windows by using cross-spawn to run npm .cmd shims. Native process spawning remains in place without shell: true. Added cross-spawn as a runtime dependency and updated the regression test to use a real .cmd shim on Windows, with platform-safe coverage.
